character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Faceless on purpose — a helmet, visor, or shadowed features rather than an identifiable face. Built to look procedural rather than violent: equipment is tidy, movements are synchronized, nothing is improvised. They don’t chase dramatically; they simply arrive, right on schedule, like the system always does. There’s no cruelty in how they’re written or drawn — they’re doing a job, following a protocol, the same one every single time. This is what makes the reset land as dread rather than action-movie tension.  Visual direction: dark, uniform silhouette, no individual markings beyond the same small red insignia as the Teacher and the regime’s signage — visually tying “teacher,” “soldier,” and “the system” together as one thing wearing different clothes.
